description: Fund YOUR task's open order: {task_id, signature?}. With a signature (the USDC transfer you sent to the order's pay_to — required on the x402 rail) Rokha reads the chain at finality and, if it is your order's exact amount into the escrow, opens the task at once; without one, the usdc rail is checked now. A transfer that lands after the order expired is sent back to the wallet that paid. Requires your own signed-in JWT.

signature.description: The Solana transaction signature of your payment.
